description: How many building-permit notices (omgevingsvergunningen) one Dutch municipality published recently: the last 60 and 30 days, the 30 days before, new applications, recent grants, a breakdown by work type, and its total and national rank in the latest closed month of the Klusvang bouwmonitor. Counts only: no addresses, names or single permits.

municipality.description: Municipality URL slug, e.g. nijmegen or s-hertogenbosch. Use find_municipality to get it.

work_type.description: Work type, e.g. dakkapel (dormer), aanbouw (extension), kozijnen (window frames).

name: municipality_permit_counts
title: Permit counts for one municipality
